_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: At 390px wide, the table of contents shows and refreshes chapters without a feature flag. The conversation /c/{{SLUG}} (ID {{ID}}) has one chapter, titled "Chapter navigation", anchored at its user message, whose data-message-id is {{ANCHOR}}. Call "retitle" renames the chapter to "Retrospective heading" on the server. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. Click the button whose accessible name is exactly "Conversation table of contents". 3. The chapter entry (".toc-entry-chapter") should have exactly the text "Chapter navigation". 4. Call "retitle". 5. Tell the page the chapters changed: eval window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("shelley-chapters-updated", { detail: "{{ID}}" })). 6. The chapter entry should then have exactly the text "Retrospective heading". 7. Click the chapter entry. 8. The URL should become exactly /c/{{SLUG}}#m-{{ANCHOR8}} (an exact URL check, not a substring).
